messages.en: I've opened the form. It's pretty complicated, isn't it?
Yeah, just fill in one section first. If there's anything we don't understand, we can ask that staff member.
Have you seen what that bag looks like? Is it nice?
Yeah. It looks just like it does in the photo, but it's a bit smaller.

collocations.en: it turns out it's already done
it turns out it was the wrong address

messages.en: My phone broke yesterday. I've only just had it fixed.
Oh, so your phone was broken. No wonder you didn't reply to my message.

senses.en_definition: The nineteenth letter of the Malay Roman alphabet, written S in uppercase.

messages.en: The word “sabar” starts with an s, right? It looks like it says “cabar” on this poster.
Yeah, s, not c. They're both words, but they mean different things.
Good thing we checked first. I'll fix it now.
